description: Postal code (CEP) input and lookup, with searching, result and error states.

howToUse: Use it on address forms, so the street, district and city fill in from the postal code (CEP).
Pass your lookup service in `lookup` and fill the other fields in `onAddressFound`.
The search runs when the CEP is complete and the field loses focus, or on the Search button. If it fails, people can still type the address.
alternatives: An address outside Brazil, or a free search for places: Input or Combobox.
Picking an area on a map: GeoAreaPicker.

keyboard.action: Moves from the field to the Search button. Leaving a complete CEP also starts the search.

props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
